description: Install or update Hexalith module config and help entries.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{inline values: skip prompts with provided values}

description: Found the conventions KB from Hexalith.AI.Tools content and framework source, with full provenance (first run).
args: {-H: headless mode}|{kb-path: explicit KB root override}

description: Read a framework release and propose KB updates as a reviewable diff; bumps targets_framework.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{release: release ref or latest}

description: Sample KB claims and check each directly against framework source; stamp verified dates, flag mismatches.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{entries: specific entry ids to verify}

description: Propose the deletion PR against Hexalith.AI.Tools for eval-passing absorbed content; update the provenance ledger.
args: {-H: headless mode}
outputs: deletion PR draft + drain progress report

description: Turn filed KB gaps (from consult, enforce, migrate, extend, create) into drafted entries for review.
args: {-H: headless mode}

description: Answer a Hexalith conformance question with cited convention ids at the configured verbosity.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{question: the conformance question}|{verbosity: terse or explain}
outputs: cited answer; gap auto-filed if unanswerable

description: Show a working conformant example for a named concept, generated or pointed into framework source.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{concept: e.g. a command handler}

description: Turn an audit or enforce finding into an explanation: the convention, why it exists, conformant form here.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{finding: convention id + code location}

description: File a structured gap entry into the KB intake queue.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{gap: what the KB should know}

description: Run the diff-scoped conformance gate (judgment layer): cited findings, waiver-aware, staleness check.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{diff: PR or working tree vs default branch}
outputs: verdict + cited findings; PR annotations in CI

description: Map which mechanical KB rules the Roslyn analyzer covers and which are gaps (analyzer backlog).
args: {-H: headless mode}

description: Draft a well-formed waiver entry (convention id, reason, review date) as a diff for human merge.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{finding: convention id + justification}

description: Repo-wide audit against current conventions: tiered gap report (mechanical/structural/judgment) with citations.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{repo: target repo path}

description: Execute the migration plan with a green gate per step; mechanical auto-fixed, judgment escalated.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{report: settled gap report path}

description: Audit every repo in the fleet manifest and aggregate: lag per repo, drift hot-spots, waiver counts.
args: {-H: headless mode}

description: Add a pure-function aggregate with its events, per-aggregate tests, and wiring — conformant by construction.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{name: aggregate name}|{behavior: behavior sketch}

description: Add a command contract with handler wiring and tests in the right packages.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{name: command name}|{payload: optional payload sketch}

description: Add an event contract with registration and tests in the right packages.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{name: event name}|{payload: optional payload sketch}

description: Add a read-model projection handler wired per conventions, with tests.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{name: projection name}

description: Add a query-side request handler per conventions, with tests.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{name: request handler name}

description: Add a Blazor Fluent UI page composed via FrontComposer, with localization stubs and tests.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{name: page name}

description: Interview (or args) to a validated machine-readable scaffold plan with convention citations.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{name: module name}|{type: technical or domain}|{target: target directory}

description: Scaffold a new Hexalith module repo correct by construction: generate, seed first aggregate, verify zero-gap.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{plan: existing scaffold plan path}|{name + type: when no plan}
